problem: NFL Rushing Yards and Receiving Yards data is present on the public mobile pages, but the intended card/grid presentation collapses into jammed browser-default text and oversized/unstructured content.
root_cause: The exact screenshot labels are emitted by the current Rushing V4 and Receiving V13 presentation owners. Both surfaces depend on CSS injected through Streamlit Markdown HTML to convert metric b/span elements into block/grid card layout. The production symptom is exactly the browser-default inline fallback expected when that CSS presentation contract is not effectively applied. The repository already contains a certified same-class repair that uses st.html for presentation transport. Existing Rushing browser certification checks DOM/text presence but does not assert getComputedStyle, allowing this visual regression class to escape. A specific Streamlit release is not blamed because version causality is not proven.
patch: No product patch in Step 1. Freeze the diagnosis and verifier gap only. Step 2 will own any presentation-transport repair and computed-style proof under a fresh Step 2A authorization.
